Author: Karunesh Singh Pawar
Bench: Karunesh Singh Pawar
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 4449 of 2021
Applicant :- Brijendra Kumar Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Singh Chauhan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the respondent/State.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. apprehending his arrest in Case Crime No.11 of 2021 under Section 408, 420 I.P.C., Police Station Mahanagar, District Lucknow.
It is submitted on behalf of the applicant that the applicant have no criminal antecedent.
Charge-sheet in the matter has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant undertakes that the applicant shall cooperate in the trial.
The applicant has not misused the liberty granted by this Court.
Learned A.G.A. for the respondent/State has opposed the bail prayer, however, does not dispute the fact that charge-sheet in the matter has been filed and the applicant has no criminal history.

sentences.text: On due consideration to the arguments advanced; perusal of the record; so also the fact that the applicant was given interim protection by this Court; the applicant has not misused the liberty given by this court; charge-sheet in the matter has been filed and the applicant has undertaken to cooperate in the trial, it would be expedient in the interest of justice that the liberty of the applicant may be protected in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, since, charge-sheet in the matter has been filed, the applicant is directed to surrender before trial court, if he is summoned to face trial for offence in question.
Any other reasonable restrictions/conditions which the trial court may deem fit and proper can be imposed.
It is made clear that the observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
In view of the aforesaid, the application is allowed.
